Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted and mis-synthesized the gathered evidence by labeling Kir as a digestif (after-dinner) and downplaying Hot Toddy’s established role as a nightcap. This contradicted the retrieved sources (e.g., Difford’s Guide showing Kir as an aperitif and Wikipedia noting Hot Toddy as a nightcap) and led to the subsequent incorrect instruction in step 12 that Kir is the bedtime drink.
